question: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi and captured Delhi and Agra in the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1526**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first battle of Panipat was fought in **1526 between Babur and Ibrahim Lodi.**
 
• ​In 1526, the Mughal forces of** Babur, the Timurid ruler of Kabulistan**, defeated the much larger ruling army of Ibrahim Lodi, Sultan of Delhi.​
 
• **Panipat **was a legendary location where after 1526, multiple battles were fought between the Mughals and varying other forces.
 
• Babur was invited by** Daulat Khan, the governor of Punjab**, to invade the region and unsettle Ibrahim Lodi.
 
• Lodi’s army relied heavily on cavalry and especially on **elephants**, which in earlier times, could shock the enemy and rout them.
 
• This battle made the** foundation of the Mughal dynasty** in India.
 
• Panipat is a historic city in** Haryana,** India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Second Battle of Panipat (1556)**:​

 
 
• It was fought between** Hemu Vikramaditya and Akbar.**
 
• Date: **November 5, 1556.**
 
 
 
• **Third Battle of Panipat (1761)**:
 
 
• It was fought between **Marathas and Ahmad Shah Durrani.**
 
• Date: **14 January 1761.**
